name: typescript
description: The TypeScript language plugin — one plugin per toolchain, this one owning the Node/TS ecosystem and so covering both `typescript` and `javascript`. A `typescript` router skill (lean SKILL.md routing to on-demand references: the coding standards baseline, Vitest testing, the build pipeline for single-package and monorepo) plus an `effect` router skill for Effect-TS doctrine, `package-json`, `pnpm`, `tsconfig`, `lint-format`, and the TypeScript/JavaScript language server. Owns every TypeScript stack template — 8 project templates (two of them `cli`: an Effect CLI and a framework-free parseArgs one), the npm-package deploy target and the pnpm/bun repo choices — and implements the vwf stack-adapter contract.
